# E0 leak decomposition: tables (generated by e0_table.py from e0_results.json)

200 sequences per pool (env seed 10000, np seed 10**6, train_newobj.evaluate's stream), T=1024 steps, 47033 object revisit targets and 93489 revisit targets per pool. n=1 seed per arm.

Floors (test pool): always-blank all-target accuracy 0.4969; object identity: chance over the pool 0.001, a uniform guess among the 16 in-sequence objects 0.0625.

Columns. intact: object-identity accuracy (argmax over the active pool's objects, revisit targets that are objects). zobj: object-token steps zeroed. zob: object and blank steps zeroed (the brief's C). L_obj = zobj - intact. L_reg = zob - intact (the brief's L). gain: RMS object step / RMS action step (intact). AUC: blank-detection AUC, intact. all: legacy all-target accuracy, intact. 3-draw conditions: mean [min, max].

NORMBOTH gives object-identity numbers identical to NORMEMB in every arm (readout scale cannot move an argmax among objects); it differs only in AUC/all (second table).
